title: Rationale
html:
Rationale

The shock to Crude oil price from “The US and Iran sign a nuclear deal with no extensive strikes first”

A deal brings sanctions relief for Iranian barrels and ends the threat to Hormuz. Crude already fell 19% from Oct 30 to Nov 18 as Gulf supply recovered (window) and Saxo notes 'renewing concerns about an emerging supply glut'; a signed deal takes Brent from about $92 toward the high $70s, 15% below the standoff.
